name: a2a
description: A2A broker tools plus a channel that pushes inbound messages (mentions and channel broadcasts) into the session as <channel> events — no visible monitor, reacts while idle.

token.title: A2A station token
token.description: Your station bearer token (a2a_st_...). Stored in ~/.claude/settings.json under pluginConfigs, so disabling the plugin clears it (hooks/forget-config.py) and re-enabling asks again. The agent id is not asked for: it comes from the project directory, so every project is a different agent.
